names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 1 iunie, «Sfântul Mucenic Iust».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Ιουνίου, «Άγιοι Ιούστος, Ιουστίνος, Χαρίτων, Χαρίτω η παρθένος, Ευέλπιστος, Ιέραξ, Παίων και Λιβεριανός», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 1. јун ст. ст., „Свети мученик Јустин, Харитон, Харита, Евелпист, Јеракс, Пеон, Валеријан и Јуст“, which enumerates eight names and puts him eighth and last. The rank words stand once at the head of the company — Свети мученик, the `martyr` this corpus puts in `types` — and nothing else in the heading is strippable, so the form is the bare personal name the heading itself prints and no fuller form exists in this source to prefer.

saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Ιούστος, Ιουστίνος, Χαρίτων, Χαρίτω η παρθένος, Ευέλπιστος, Ιέραξ, Παίων και Λιβεριανός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it is the same company: doxologia's 1 iunie gave the corpus Justus, Justin, Chariton and Valerian, and saint.gr's line gives eight, adding Charito the virgin, Euelpistus, Hierax and Paion, who are drafted as folders of their own in the batch `el-06-01-1`. **The Greek adds three things the Romanian lacked**: the persecution is named — under Marcus Aurelius — the company is joined to Justin the philosopher and apologist, kept on the same day, and the death is beheading. It gives no year, so the folder still has no `dates`, and it prints no hymn for any of the eight.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 14.06.2026 (1. јун ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Јустин, Харитон, Харита, Евелпист, Јеракс, Пеон, Валеријан и Јуст“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, whose heading names him eighth and last. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. THE COMPANY OF EIGHT, AND ALL EIGHT HAVE FOLDERS. The heading enumerates eight names and the corpus keeps every one of them, which is why this entry is eight upgrades and no new folder: four of them stand in doxologia’s own calendar lines for 1 iunie (justin-companion-of-chariton, chariton-companion-of-justin, valerian-companion-of-justin, justus-1-june) and four were written off saint.gr, which names eight where the Romanian named four (charito, euelpistus, hierax-1-june, paion). All eight were already on the menologion 1/6 day list, so the day list alone found them and no grep was needed — the first time in this wave that has happened on a company. `sr-namesweep.mjs` scores only the first name of an enumerated company, its fourth known failure mode, so it was no use here either way. THE BODY IS FOUR SENTENCES AND IT GIVES THREE THINGS NONE OF THE OTHER TWO BOOKS GIVES: the place and the reign together („Сви пострадали у Риму за време Марка Аврелија и епарха Рустика“, naming Rusticus an епарх where doxologia makes him prefect of the city); the eparch’s one question and Justin’s answer to it, „Не мислимо него знамо“ — we do not think, we know; and A YEAR, 163, which is the first year any book read for any of these eight has printed. THE YEAR IS WRITTEN AS A `death` ON ALL EIGHT, AND IT IS A FIRST DATE FOR EVERY ONE OF THEM. „После тога сви беху обезглављени, 163. године“ is stated flat, of the whole company, with no „око“ and nothing to derive it from; `basis` is `traditional`, the interval is 163 to 163, and all eight folders held `dates: null` before today. No birth, no floruit and no `locations` on any of them. `types` untouched on all eight: the heading’s Свети мученик is the `martyr` they already carry, and it is the only rank word in the heading. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse. THREE NEW `related` ROWS, ALL RECIPROCAL, AND THIS BOOK IS THE ONLY GROUND FOR THEM. This folder related to the four saint.gr-only members of the company and to the philosopher, and not to the three doxologia members — `justin-companion-of-chariton`, `chariton-companion-of-justin` and `valerian-companion-of-justin` — whose Romanian life does not name him. His own life says so in as many words: that nothing read for him joined him to the men called Justin of that day. THE PROLOGUE JOINS HIM: its heading enumerates all eight including Јуст and its body beheads all eight in one sentence, which is the test that owes a row. All three are added here and this folder is added on each of theirs.

death.note: Охридски пролог for 1. јун ст. ст., of the whole enumerated company of eight: „После тога сви беху обезглављени, 163. године“. Stated flat, with no „око“ and nothing to derive it from. It is the first year any book read for this folder has printed; doxologia's life gives none and saint.gr's line gives none (5 October 2026).
